description.value: Osteria Savio Volpe is a Vancouver Italian restaurant modelled on the classic osteria tradition, serving rustic fare built around handmade pasta crafted daily and proteins finished over a wood-fired grill and rotisserie. The menu leans heavily on locally sourced ingredients from BC's lakes, oceans, farms and fields, interpreted through an Italian lens with an extensive list of Italian wines. A touring cyclist arriving for dinner would find a warm, convivial sit-down experience on Kingsway celebrating fresh, regional cooking in a lively neighbourhood setting.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 7m; stands (2 spaces) at 16m; stands (2 spaces) at 25m; stands (2 spaces) at 26m; stands (2 spaces) at 34m; stands at 89m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, full-service Italian osteria at 615 Kingsway, Vancouver, matching the OSM address and phone number exactly. The website content covers the menu, about, hiring, and contact pages in detail but contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities. The /locations page confirms street parking along Kingsway and 15th Avenue (car parking only), which does not constitute evidence of bike parking.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed address, and active reservations system. A legitimate dinner destination for touring cyclists on Kingsway.
enrichment_extras.notes: The /locations page references street parking along Kingsway and 15th Avenue (car parking only); no bike-specific parking information was found anywhere on the site.
